statement: An estimate, not results. Two failure modes nobody prices in: churn, where losing 3 clients at flat pricing is roughly $15,000 of MRR, and distribution. The reported growth engine behind the famous case was about 6 million cumulative tweet impressions built over years. The tools got cheap. The audience never did.
